goals.title: Reality check, repository boundary ADR, threat model, schema, and empirical baseline
Durable single-writer WAL, content-addressed blob store, checkpointing, and crash fault injection
Capability-scoped Ed25519 auth, bounded paginated read/proposal API, virtual tree inspection, and path index
Deterministic Git object materialization, GitHub PR projection, and Radicle delegate threshold verifier
Comparative concurrent agent benchmark against Git worktrees, conformance suites, and qualification receipt

Close the Gate 4 measured gaps, each reported in seconds and joules per accepted change next to a physical bound: durable group commit, read path, bounded virtual tree cache, compact wire format and local daemon socket
Small Git bridge: native ref and history contracts, full-history Git import and export, git-remote-synapse remote helper
AI-native model: best ideas from every system, each adopted only for a concrete AI-agent need (ADR 0003)
Agent cutover: hive agents use Synapse as their primary system after the ADR 0002 cutover gates pass; legacy human edge adapters removed
Native on AIEN hardware: Synapse hot path written in Omega on AIENOS, talking directly to the hardware (raw block storage, no filesystem), Git as an import and export edge only
